robot.name: Fourier GR-3
robot.generation: full-size 'Care-bot' humanoid; first full-size companion humanoid from Fourier
robot.status_notes: TechNode reported on 2025-08-07 that Fourier expected deployment in nursing homes and rehabilitation centers; CES demos in Jan 2026; ROBOTio mentions a PERKESO demonstration in June 2026; Robopear states status rests on vendor statements only with no independent pilot/delivery documented as of 2026-10-20.

height.notes: Consistent across TechNode, PR Newswire, ROBOTio and Robopear.

payload.notes: Single-hand/arm load capacity per ROBOTio, Robotix Market and Robopear.

runtime.notes: Robofy says 3 hours per charge with dual hot-swappable batteries enabling 6 hours continuous operation; conflicting with 3 h runtime claim.

battery.notes: Two batteries listed: 702 Wh main and 234 Wh hot-swap. Robopear also lists 702 / 234 Wh; charging time 1.5 h.

degrees_of_freedom.notes: Published as 55 DoF; Robopear notes this is for 12-DoF hand version, standard hands are 6 DoF per hand.

walking_speed.notes: Robopear checked fftai.com and lists 1.53 m/s; ROBOTio lists 6.1 km/h (about 1.69 m/s). Version conflict noted.

hands.description: Optional 12-DoF hands with tactile arrays; standard version has 6 DoF per hand; 31 touch and pressure sensors on head and torso.
hands.force_feedback: tactile arrays on optional 12-DoF hands; 31 touch/pressure sensors

items: Full-Perception Multimodal Interaction System integrating visual, audio and tactile sensing
31 touch sensors on head and torso

compute.description: AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS (8-core/16-thread), Ubuntu 22.04; hybrid decision architecture merging fast reflexive control with language-model reasoning.

actuators.description: 55 total DoF; peak joint torque 440 N·m per ROBOTio manufacturer data; 7-DoF arms, 6-DoF legs, 3-DoF waist, 2-DoF head/neck.

availability.notes: No official public price; ROBOTio says manufacturer price not published and is on request. Robotix Market lists $119,995 and Robofy lists $28K-$120K, but these are third-party reseller/directory figures. Robopear confirms enterprise quote only and no list price on vendor channels checked 2026-10-20.

manipulation_dexterity.summary: GR-3 has two 7-DoF arms, 3 kg per-hand payload, optional 12-DoF hands with tactile arrays and 31 touch sensors on head/torso. A CES video title references dexterous hands. No detailed manipulation task metrics or independent success rates found.
caveats: No transcript or observable video analyzed; dexterity based on specs and video title only.
3 kg payload is modest for many physical tasks.

autonomy_task_execution.summary: Fourier claims a hybrid decision architecture merging fast reflexive control with language-model reasoning; live chess at CES implies perception and planning but execution mode is not disclosed. No autonomous task benchmarks or intervention data found.
caveats: Teleoperation/autonomy not disclosed for any demo.
No independent verification of autonomy claims.

mobility_whole_body_control.summary: 55 DoF; published walking speed 1.53 m/s (Robopear) or 6.1 km/h (ROBOTio); scheduled dance sessions at CES highlighted fluid whole-body movement and balance; a CES video is titled 'Fourier GR-3 Humanoid Robot in Motion'.
caveats: Walking speed sources conflict; not independently measured.
No stability, fall-rate or disturbance-recovery metrics found.

perception_scene_understanding.summary: Full-Perception Multimodal Interaction System integrates visual, audio and tactile sensing; Foucault? No, Fourier claims it can localize voices, track users' movements, recognize subtle touch and perceive a chess board in real time.
caveats: Company claims only; no third-party perception benchmark or independent validation.

human_interaction.summary: Designed for natural conversation, emotion recognition, touch response, dance and chess; CES booth offered conversational/touch activities and live chess. Official videos emphasize caring companion and emotions; soft animal-like head and GFOAM shell lower social barriers.
caveats: No third-party evaluation of emotional intelligence or conversational reliability.
CES demos are curated booth interactions; video content not transcribed.

endurance_reliability.summary: Runtime approximately 3 hours per charge; battery 702 Wh + 234 Wh hot-swap; Robofy says dual hot-swappable batteries enable 6 hours continuous operation; charging time 1.5 h. No long-term operation data, failure rates or uptime logs found.
caveats: Directory specs, not independently measured.
6 h continuous operation claim conflicts with 3 h per charge; source is a comparison directory.

human_environment_fit.summary: 165 cm, 71 kg, soft upholstered GFOAM shell, Morandi colours, animal-like head and 31 touch sensors; targeted for care homes, public spaces, assisted settings and educational facilities. CES booth allowed public interaction.
caveats: No safety certification or collaborative-operation standard found for the full robot.
A 71 kg humanoid with 440 N·m peak torque may pose risks in close human proximity.

deployment_commercial_proof.summary: No named customer deployment independently confirmed. ROBOTio mentions a demonstration at PERKESO rehabilitation centre in Malaysia in June 2026, but Robopear states status rests on vendor statements only with no independent pilot or delivery documented.
caveats: PERKESO claim is third-party and unverified.
No unit counts, operating hours, customer names or outcome metrics.

accessibility_value.summary: No official price or purchase path. ROBOTio says manufacturer price is on request and no official EU distribution/service confirmation. Reseller Robotix Market lists $119,995; Robofy lists $28K-$120K. No purchase URL found from Fourier.
caveats: Reseller prices conflict and are not official manufacturer pricing.
No confirmed public availability outside enterprise inquiry.

evidence_items.title: TechNode reports launch specs and care use cases
evidence_items.claim: GR-3 is 165 cm tall, 71 kg, has 55 degrees of freedom, integrates auditory/visual/tactile modules, supports emotion recognition and natural dialogue, and is expected in nursing homes and rehabilitation centers.
evidence_items.notes: Credible media reporting company launch; values are company claims.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Establishes core size, DoF, sensory system and intended care deployment.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Standing 165cm tall and weighing 71kg, the robot offers 55 degrees of body freedom.
evidence_items.verification_notes: TechNode links to Fourier's Chinese WeChat post; company claims not independently measured.

evidence_items.title: ROBOTio aggregates manufacturer specs for GR-3
evidence_items.claim: ROBOTio lists GR-3 as 165 cm, 71 kg, 55 DoF, soft upholstered shell, 31 touch sensors, 3 kg arm payload, 6.1 km/h walking, 440 N·m peak joint torque, 702 Wh + 234 Wh hot-swap battery, AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS and Ubuntu 22.04.
evidence_items.notes: Third-party directory presenting manufacturer data; not independently measured.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Most complete public spec sheet source in the pack.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: The "Care-bot" from Shanghai-based Fourier — 165 cm, 71 kg, 55 degrees of freedom, a soft upholstered shell and 31 touch sensors for care, rehabilitation and companionship.
evidence_items.verification_notes: Names manufacturer data but source is a European event/rental directory; walking speed conflicts with Robopear 1.53 m/s.

evidence_items.title: ROBOTio mentions PERKESO rehab centre demonstration
evidence_items.claim: ROBOTio states GR-3 was demonstrated at the PERKESO rehabilitation centre in Malaysia in June 2026 for cognitive training and guiding.
evidence_items.notes: Single third-party directory mention; no official confirmation from PERKESO or Fourier.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Potential early care-site validation, but not creditworthy as commercial deployment.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Cognitive training and guiding; demonstrated at the PERKESO rehabilitation centre in Malaysia (June 2026).
evidence_items.verification_notes: No primary source, unit count, duration or outcome provided; treat as unverified rumor-tier claim.

evidence_items.title: Robotix Market reseller listing with price
evidence_items.claim: Robotix Market lists GR-3 for $119,995, with 55 DoF, 165 cm, 71 kg, 3 kg hand payload and about 3 hours runtime.
evidence_items.notes: Third-party reseller; not an official Fourier price.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Only public numeric price found, but not official; should be flagged as unverified.
evidence_items.verification_notes: Reseller site; price may not reflect manufacturer pricing; no source for runtime claim beyond listing.

evidence_items.title: Robopear status: vendor claims only
evidence_items.claim: Robopear, after checking vendor pages on 2026-10-20, says no list price is published, status rests on vendor statements, and no independent demonstration, pilot or delivery is documented as of 2026-10-20.
evidence_items.notes: Independent directory analysis, but still not primary evidence; useful caveat.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Status rests on vendor statements only: no independent demonstration, pilot or delivery is documented as of 20 Oct 2026.
evidence_items.verification_notes: Robopear checked fftai.com, support-old.fftai.com and PR Newswire; not a customer or testing source.

evidence_items.title: Robofy directory lists conflicting price and runtime
evidence_items.claim: Robofy's comparison lists GR-3 at $28K-$120K, 3 hours per charge, and says dual hot-swappable batteries enable 6 hours continuous operation.
evidence_items.notes: Directory with estimated values; conflicts with ROBOTio and Robotix.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Additional price range and endurance caveat.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: 3 hours per charge; dual hot-swappable batteries enable 6 hours continuous operation
evidence_items.verification_notes: Estimated/unofficial data; '3 kg payload' from official Fourier documentation per source but not verified.

deployments.site_or_context: Malaysia (claimed by ROBOTio, not confirmed by PERKESO or Fourier)
caveats: Only source is third-party directory ROBOTio.

limitations_and_unknowns.description: No official price, pre-order or retail channel found. Fourier sells via enterprise inquiry only; Robotix Market and Robofy post conflicting third-party prices.
No confirmed named customer deployment. ROBOTio mentions PERKESO demo but without confirmation; Robopear says status rests on vendor statements only.
limitations_and_unknowns.impact_on_arena_scoring: Commercial proof is effectively absent; do not credit care-site deployment.

limitations_and_unknowns.description: No demo or source states whether GR-3 actions were autonomous or teleoperated. The hybrid decision architecture is a company claim only.
limitations_and_unknowns.impact_on_arena_scoring: Credit interaction and motion demos, but keep autonomy confidence very low.

limitations_and_unknowns.description: No evaluation or metric supports emotion recognition, natural dialogue or care utility beyond company statements and curated CES booth interactions.
limitations_and_unknowns.impact_on_arena_scoring: Human-interaction scores should reflect design intent, not proven reliability.

limitations_and_unknowns.description: Walking speed conflicts: ROBOTio 6.1 km/h vs Robopear 1.53 m/s. Hand DoF is 6 standard/12 optional; total DoF 55 depends on hand configuration. No official price.
limitations_and_unknowns.impact_on_arena_scoring: Do not infer one canonical DoF or speed; use ranges/caveats.

limitations_and_unknowns.description: No safety certification or risk assessment found for GR-3. A 71 kg humanoid with 440 N·m peak torque requires caution in care settings.

researcher_notes.short_verdict_for_arena: Fourier GR-3 is a full-size service/care humanoid with strong design and interaction claims, but public evidence is mostly company statements, directory specs and video titles. No independent deployment, autonomy proof or official price exists.
strongest_positive_evidence: Consistent 165 cm, 71 kg, 55 DoF specs across TechNode, PR Newswire and directories.
CES 2026 public booth interactions (conversation, touch, dance, chess) described in official press release.
Official Fourier videos titled 'How to Be a Good Robot?' and 'A Caring and Capable Companion'.
Detailed manufacturer spec sheet via ROBOTio (3h runtime, 31 touch sensors, AMD compute, soft shell).
weakest_or_missing_evidence: No confirmed named customer deployment or pilot metrics.
No autonomy/teleoperation disclosure for any demo.
No independent verification, benchmark, failure rate or safety certification.
No official price; reseller prices conflict ($28K-$120K vs $119,995).
conflicting_claims: Runtime: 3 hours per charge vs Robofy claim of 6 hours continuous with hot-swap.
Price: $119,995 Robotix Market vs $28K-$120K Robofy; no official price.
do_not_overclaim: Do not credit PERKESO as confirmed deployment.
Do not infer autonomy from video titles or PRNewswire.
Do not treat directory specs as independently measured.
Do not use GR-1 or GR-2 specs for GR-3.
Do not credit GR-3C teleoperation variants as GR-3.

currentness.currentness_notes: GR-3 is Fourier's current care-focused full-size humanoid as of 2026-10-29. GR-2 and GR-1 are prior generations. Robopear's check date is 2026-10-20.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: Fourier GR-3 is a full-size service/care humanoid (165 cm, 71 kg, 55 DoF, soft shell, 31 touch sensors) announced August 2025 and shown publicly at CES 2026 in conversation, touch, dance and chess interactions. The strongest evidence is consistent official/company specification and CES booth demo descriptions, plus official videos titled around caring and behavior. However, no autonomous execution proof, no confirmed customer deployment, no independent metrics and no official price exist; directory sources conflict on walking speed, runtime and price. Treat GR-3 as an early-stage care humanoid with design strengths but unverified commercial and autonomy claims.
strongest_evidence: Consistent 165 cm / 71 kg / 55 DoF specs (TechNode, PR Newswire, directories).
CES 2026 public booth interaction descriptions (PR Newswire).
Official Fourier video titles 'How to Be a Good Robot?' and 'A Caring and Capable Companion'.
weakest_evidence: No confirmed named customer deployment or pilot metrics.
No official price or public purchase path.
known_do_not_credit: PERKESO rehabilitation centre as confirmed deployment.
Autonomous operation from video titles or press release.
